@calendarPreviousMonth.description: The accessible name of the button showing the month before in a calendar: GtkCalendar's tooltip, and on macOS NSDatePicker's left arrow, which AppKit leaves unnamed.

@calendarNextMonth.description: The accessible name of the button showing the month after in a calendar: GtkCalendar's tooltip, and on macOS NSDatePicker's right arrow, which AppKit leaves unnamed.

@calendarPreviousYear.description: The accessible name of GtkCalendar's button showing the year before, its tooltip.

@calendarNextYear.description: The accessible name of GtkCalendar's button showing the year after, its tooltip.

@calendarToday.description: The accessible name of the dot between NSDatePicker's arrows on macOS, which goes to today and which AppKit leaves unnamed.

@calendarPrevious.description: The accessible name of WinUI's CalendarView PreviousButton (UIA_FLIPVIEW_PREVIOUS).

@calendarNext.description: The accessible name of WinUI's CalendarView NextButton (UIA_FLIPVIEW_NEXT).

@pipsPagerName.description: The accessible name of a pager's row of page indicators: WinUI's PipsPager name (PipsPagerNameText).

@pipsPagerPage.description: The accessible name of a page indicator, as in "Page 3": WinUI's PipsPagerPageText followed by the page's number (PipsPager::OnElementPrepared).

@carouselPage.description: The accessible name of a carousel's view, which takes the focus, as in "Page 2 of 4": the page shown and how many there are, as a screen reader says them for a pip of WinUI's PipsPager (page x of y).

@carouselPrevious.description: The accessible name of WinUI's FlipView PreviousButtonHorizontal, which shows the page before (UIA_FLIPVIEW_PREVIOUS).

@carouselNext.description: The accessible name of WinUI's FlipView NextButtonHorizontal, which shows the page after (UIA_FLIPVIEW_NEXT).

@datePickerPlaceholder.description: What a date picker without a date shows: WinUI's CalendarDatePicker's default PlaceholderText (TEXT_CALENDARDATEPICKER_DEFAULT_PLACEHOLDER_TEXT).
